scratch/design.md gained item 22a and item 23 changed: launching is three levels, each with its own states and built only on the one below — machine launcher (machines exist or not; knows no jobs), job launcher (queues and places runs; knows no experiments), experiment launcher (the pass). Map them onto the modules that already exist, fix boundary crossings, and enforce one import rule per boundary; do not move modules that already sit right.
